entries.title: Compact 3-bedroom rectangle, near-square
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Near-square rectangle (ratio ~0.95-1.05), spine organisation, master ensuite plus two bedrooms sharing a family bathroom.

entries.title: 4-bedroom family rectangle
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Near-square footprint, guest WC off the entry, private wing organised around a compact room lobby.

entries.title: 2-bedroom starter house, rectangle
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Smallest program in the set; single shared bathroom, open-plan public zone.

entries.title: 5-bedroom rectangle with two ensuites
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Two ensuite bedrooms plus a family bathroom and guest WC; near-square footprint at the upper end of the private-house area range.

entries.title: 3-bedroom rectangle, room-lobby hub
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Compact room-lobby (~2.5-3.5 m square) private-wing circulation hub, matching the census's dominant private-wing organisation (specs/005-hub-private-wing/spec.md).

entries.title: 4-bedroom rectangle with safe room
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: One bedroom doubles as the mandated safe room (ממ"ד), labelled 'bedroom / security room' as in the census.

entries.title: 6-bedroom large rectangle
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Largest single-level rectangle in the set; hub organisation keeps wing depth constant despite the bedroom count, per the census finding.

entries.title: 3-bedroom two-storey rectangle
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Ground floor open-plan public zone; bedrooms upstairs around a shared landing.

entries.title: 4-bedroom two-storey rectangle
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Master ensuite upstairs, guest WC on the ground floor next to the entrance.

entries.title: 2-bedroom rectangle, guest annex
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Small rectangle with a half-bath (guest WC) in addition to the family bathroom.

entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Wide footprint (ratio ~1.15), public zones spread across the street front, corridor and bedroom columns behind.

entries.title: 4-bedroom wide rectangle, front band
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Wide footprint with a side-by-side bedroom wing regime (≥12.5 m wide), guest WC near the entrance.

entries.title: 2-bedroom wide rectangle, compact
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Wide, shallow footprint on a broad, shallow plot; single shared bathroom.

entries.title: 5-bedroom wide rectangle, hub organisation
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Wide footprint, private wing around a compact room lobby with 5-6 doors opening onto it.

entries.title: 3-bedroom two-storey wide rectangle
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Wide ground floor for the public zone; bedrooms upstairs across the same width.

entries.title: 4-bedroom wide rectangle with flex room
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Wide footprint with an extra flexible room (home office / study) off the entrance.

entries.title: 6-bedroom large wide rectangle
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Largest wide-rectangle entry; side-by-side bedroom wings on a broad plot.

entries.title: 2-bedroom two-storey wide rectangle
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Small two-storey house on a wide, shallow lot; both bedrooms upstairs.

entries.title: 3-bedroom narrow-deep, spine corridor
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Deep footprint (ratio ~0.75) on a narrow plot; single spine corridor is the only organisation that fits this ratio.

entries.title: 4-bedroom narrow-deep, spine corridor
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Narrow semi-detached lot; rear garden the full plot width, long single-loaded corridor.

entries.title: 2-bedroom narrow-deep, small lot
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Smallest narrow-deep entry, single bathroom shared, no room for a hub organisation at this width.

entries.title: 5-bedroom narrow-deep, spine corridor
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Long spine corridor carries five bedrooms on a narrow lot; deepest footprint in the set.

entries.title: 3-bedroom two-storey narrow-deep
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Narrow semi-detached lot; splitting across two storeys keeps the footprint depth manageable.

entries.title: 4-bedroom narrow-deep with safe room
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: One bedroom is the mandated safe room; narrow lot forces a single-loaded corridor.

entries.title: 2-bedroom two-storey narrow-deep
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Small narrow-deep house on two storeys, ground floor public zone the full plot width.

entries.title: 6-bedroom large narrow-deep
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Largest narrow-deep entry; the census's #1 measured quality gap (long single spine, hall long/short median 9.4) is deliberately represented here for benchmark contrast.

entries.title: 3-bedroom L-shape, corner plot
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Two-wing L on a corner plot; bedrooms in their own arm, entry court formed by the L.

entries.title: 4-bedroom L-shape, wide plot
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: L-shape needs a plot that holds a rectangle of roughly 0.6x the total area plus a second wing sharing a full side; sheltered terrace in the L's corner.

entries.title: 5-bedroom L-shape, two-wing
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: 13 of the census's 21 plans were non-rectangular; this entry represents the L family's dominant two-wing-with-seam pattern, circulation crossing the seam through a hall.

entries.title: 3-bedroom two-storey L-shape
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: One wing single-storey, one wing two-storey; bedrooms occupy the taller wing's upper floor.

entries.title: 2-bedroom compact L-shape
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Smallest L in the set; short second wing holds both bedrooms off a shared bathroom.

entries.title: 4-bedroom L-shape with safe room
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Safe room placed in the bedroom wing, away from the entry-court wing.

entries.title: 4-bedroom U/courtyard plan
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Three wings around an inner courtyard on a large plot (frontage ≳ 20 m); ring circulation, one of only 2 of 21 census plans with this organisation.

entries.title: 5-bedroom angled/irregular footprint
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Angled/cross footprint following an irregular plot boundary, part of the census's non-rectangular majority.

entries.title: 3-bedroom T-shape footprint
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: T-shaped footprint, one arm public, one arm private, stem holds shared circulation.

entries.title: 4-bedroom two-storey courtyard plan
entries.source: Internal architectural quality-gap census archetype (see README V1 provenance note)
entries.notes: Ground floor wraps a courtyard on three sides; upper floor sits over one wing only, bedrooms there.
